text:
maya: FYI - two pilot customers paused Dedicated onboarding. ask: route-level cost + compact error slices before they greenlight. can we propose a narrow ship that gets them unblocked this quarter? :eyes:

tony: short plan: route cost table + top-trace link + simple error-rate chart per route. keep span-level rollups for later. estimated effort: 3 dev days + 2 infra days + docs.

ben: main risk is attribution. do we reuse token attribution or create route-tag propagation in billing tags? reuse wins time but may miss some routed proxies.

maya: prioritize reuse for MVP if accuracy is within 10% for high-volume routes. acceptance: route cost within 10% of nightly batch for common routes; error signal stable 24h; docs + one customer signoff.

sarah: customers also want a lightweight "what-if" for batching impact per-route as a stretch. they called it a showstopper if missing in long term, but ok as stretch for first beta.

ton y: sampling approach: deterministic reservoir per route with sticky sample ids so traces for a request correlate across services. i'll spike 2 days to validate.

ben: infra needs a short-lived validation pipeline (1-2 weeks) and a small billing-tag change to push route ids. i've talked to ops; they'll approve once ticket exists.

devex-bot: Action reminder - update SDK changelog and release-notes template with a feature blurb. (assignee: @maya)

maya: split deliverables: MVP-1 = per-route cost table, error-rate by route, trace link; MVP-2 = what-if slider, sampling controls, richer error buckets. target MVP-1 for sprint 12.

ton y: spike opened (card #4567). if reuse possible, impl drops to ~3 dev-days.

ben: creating infra ticket now and tagging billing + ops. will request ephemeral instance for testing.

sarah: i'll schedule two acceptance sessions with the pilots and draft pass/fail scenarios.

maya: owners: tony (sampling + impl), ben (infra + billing tags), sarah (customer validation), maya (docs + comms). next sync Thurs 9am to lock acceptance tests. :thumbsup:
